Yes, `uuid` exposes `uuid7()` in this snapshot, and it was added in Python 3.14.

```json
{"facts": {"available": true, "added": "3.14"}}
```

`library/uuid.rst` documents `.. function:: uuid7()`, which generates a time-based UUID. The same file notes that `UUID.version` gained support for UUID versions 6, 7 and 8 in 3.14 (`versionchanged:: 3.14`). The `versionadded:: 3.14` marker I saw sits just before the `uuid7()` definition, at the end of the `uuid6()` entry, so I'm inferring that it applies to `uuid7()` as well. I did not read the `uuid7()` entry itself to confirm its own marker.
